posts.content:
we just repositioned PostHog around self-driving product in 6 weeks. i wrote about what we did, and how and why we did it. 

lots of hard work is still ahead of us to now repeat the message consistently, but there is no reason why the initial phase should take 6-12 months of committees and planning and decks, even as a 220 person company. 

i think to even have a _chance_ of succeeding, you need to:
- have founders that are totally bought in
- have a small group making final decisions (literally like 3 people)
- disagree and commit a bunch when your amazing idea doesn't make it
- be open to some metrics looking temporarily worse for long term gain
- not sweat product names too much (aka nerd sniping for marketers)
- get it out there and keep asking your sales team what customers think
- keep refining based on what users say but don't make wholesale changes
